stack.$comment: Vertical rhythm as one flex column with a gap — so the space between blocks is chosen from the spacing scale in one place instead of being the sum of whatever margins the blocks brought with them. Three steps, not a free length: rhythm is a system decision, and the scale is the system (req-token-names — the same three words as everywhere else).
stack.$comment-gap: The base step, and the `md` value by the size rule: the unsuffixed name IS the middle of the axis (req-api-size). One 16px step of the spacing scale — the distance at which two blocks read as neighbours in one flow.
stack.$comment-gap-sm: The tight step, for rows inside a card or a label over its control — related things standing closer than separate things.
stack.$comment-gap-lg: The loose step, for sections of a page — far enough apart that each reads as its own beginning. The scale grew its 24px step for this token; nothing below the section level needs it.
